title: Ignition Specifications — 5.0L 32V Ti-VCT
introduction:
A spark plug gives the ignition coil a controlled gap inside the combustion chamber. I check the engine label before using this table: the gap belongs to the specified engine arrangement, even when another plug on the shelf looks ready to audition.

Use the Spark plug row as the identifier printed here and the Spark plug gap row as a range, expressed in inches and millimeters. This reference does not establish a complete replacement ordering number, a gap-adjustment method or the access and torque instructions for installation.

edits.text: Spark Plug Identification and Gap Range
edits.why: Read this table within the stated engine applicability. The plug identifier and gap range answer different questions: which entry is referenced and what gap is specified. Preserve both range endpoints and their units; the table does not authorize an electrode-adjustment technique.
